hooks.name: Auto-commit after task

action.prompt: Run pnpm --filter @necro/oracle typecheck and test. If both pass, git add the changed files (never .env or secrets) and commit with the message "Spec 01 task <number>: <task title>". Do not push. If anything fails, do not commit; fix it first.

hooks.description: Typecheck, test and commit after each spec task
